pages.description: Offering impressive performance, practicality, and a stunning design, the Enigma has a top speed of 10km/h meaning riders can zip around with ease.
pages.ld_description: ENIGMA ELECTRIC SCOOTER: Offering impressive performance, practicality, and a stunning design, the Enigma has a top speed of 12km/h meaning riders can zip around with ease. QUICK TO CHARGE: The 24V lithium rechargeable battery gives up to 1 hour of fun on a single 2-3 hour charge, with faster recharging, lighter weight and longer lifespan than standard batteries, so your little rider spends more time playing /// THUMB THROTTLE CONTROL: Enjoy smooth acceleration and precise speed control with the easy-to-use thumb throttle. For added safety, the rear brake provides reliable stopping power.FOLDABLE DESIGN: The foldable functionality allows for convenient storage and portability, while the kickstand ensures the scooter stays upright and secure when not in motion. Folded Dimensions: L80cm x W40cm x H24cmDESIGNED FOR AGES 6 AND UP: With adjustable handlebar height and a max user weight of 50kg, the scooter is perfect for kids aged 6 through to teens. Scooter dimensions: L80cm x W40cm x H82-95cmAWARD-WINNING PRODUCT: The Enigma has earned widespread recognition, winning top awards like The Big Christmas Wishlist, Independent Toy Awards and more
